Name: Frappe
Desc: Frappe Framework (the platform under ERPNext) serving a single site through gunicorn/nginx Desk APIs, with MariaDB for data, a Redis cache, and a Redis queue (RQ) drained by a long-queue background worker. Background work includes emails, prepared report exports and scheduled jobs. Ported from Incident Arena. An `ops-toolbox` pod provides an operator shell: mysql with the MariaDB root DSN in $DB_ADMIN_DSN, python3, and reconfigure-infra.sh for bounded Redis queue repairs (it applies them through the frappe-admin service so they survive a broker restart). MariaDB and Redis exporters are scraped by Prometheus.
Supported Operations: Browse, search and load dashboards in Desk
Enqueue and complete background jobs (emails, report exports, scheduled jobs)
